title: PermissionError while retrying a failed upload (policy.check)
body:
## Environment

Running Lattice 3.0.1 on Windows Server 2022 against ca-
central-1.

## Steps

Steps to reproduce:
* Start by retrying a failed upload.
* Open the target file in a viewer, then trigger the action.
* Wait for the failure and read the log.

## Expected

As on every earlier run, retrying a failed upload should
just complete.

## Actual

It is denied once, then the same action works on retry.
Another process still has the file open when the app tries
to replace it.

## Frequency

Happens only on the first run after login.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:50 in loop
lattice/ui/upload.py:34 in on_drop
lattice/io/upload.py:115 in send
lattice/auth/policy.py:128 in check
PermissionError: upload denied for role 'viewer'
